findings.title: Viewer startup exception blocks entire orchestrator launch
findings.evidence: If `EnableStretchEndpoints` is `true` and `ScreenshotRootPath` is null or does not exist on disk, the viewer throws `InvalidOperationException` at startup.
findings.problem: ViewerHost.Start is invoked from OrchestratorProgram.Main after DI; a stretch config error halts modeling sessions entirely.
findings.why_it_matters: Violates 'leaf module', 'no impact on agent loop', and 'hackathon baseline' framing; opposite assumption (stretch features optional) is not honored.
findings.proposed_fix: Make validation non-fatal: log, disable stretch features internally, allow orchestrator to start regardless.

findings.title: Omission of repository method for mandatory shallow validation status
findings.location: Section 4.1 GET / (TimelineViewModel population), Section 6 (hash chain header), SDR-06-005
findings.evidence: TimelineViewModel populated via ListSessionsAsync and ListEntriesAsync only; yet UI displays 'hash chain: valid (shallow)' and 'Shallow hash-chain validation runs when the timeline renders'
findings.problem: No GetShallowValidationStatusAsync or equivalent defined on IReadOnlyDhfRepository, nor in ViewModel contract.
findings.why_it_matters: Core mandatory timeline (ACC-08) cannot be implemented without guessing the missing API; creates downstream rework exactly where SPEC-04 dependency was meant to be narrow.
findings.proposed_fix: Explicitly add and document the shallow status method on the read-only interface with exact return shape.

findings.title: Brittle screenshot path guards vulnerable to bypass under adversarial input
findings.location: Section 9. Screenshot Serving (Stretch), 'Path traversal guards' numbered list
findings.evidence: 1. Guid.TryParse on addinSessionId 2. regex ^[0-9]+_[0-9a-fA-F\-]+\.png$ plus explicit .. checks 3. Path.GetFullPath prefix check after Path.Combine
findings.problem: Does not address URL-encoded traversal (%2e%2e), NTFS alternate data streams (file.png:stream), symlink following inside root, or route model binding normalization differences across ASP.NET versions.
findings.why_it_matters: Spec assumes perfect data and 'localhost-only' (SDR-06-002); if opposite assumption holds (port forwarded, dev tunnel, post-hackathon deployment), arbitrary file read becomes possible. Tests only cover explicit malicious examples.
findings.proposed_fix: Replace custom guards with ASP.NET FileProvider or dedicated safe static-file middleware that normalizes and constrains at the filesystem layer; expand ScreenshotPathTraversalTests to include encoded and stream variants.

findings.title: Cross-spec dictate on SPEC-04 isolation level creates untestable contract
findings.location: Section 10. Read Consistency (listed as new Section 5.5 in changelog), final bullet on deep validation
findings.evidence: `IReadOnlyDhfRepository.ValidateChainAsync` must honor an `IsolationLevel` parameter or internally guarantee snapshot consistency.
findings.problem: This spec (leaf, read-only) is dictating internal transaction semantics of the depended-on SPEC-04 repository; no method signature, no test double contract, no version pin.
findings.why_it_matters: If SPEC-04 implements repeatable-read differently or omits the parameter, deep integrity endpoint will produce false tamper reports under concurrent appends—the exact scenario the section claims to solve. Brittle external actor dependency.
findings.proposed_fix: Move concrete ValidateChainAsync signature and isolation requirements into SPEC-04's interface definition; reference that definition here instead of imposing requirements.
